readings.title: The Arrival of Absolute Justice
readings.subtitle: A Consuming Fire from Tsiyon
readings.text: [Psalm 50:1] <dn>Ěl</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall speak, And <dn>He</dn> shall call <dn>את</dn> the earth From the rising of the sun to its going down. [2] From Tsiyon, the perfection of loveliness, <dn>Elohim</dn> shall shine forth. [3] Our <dn>Elohim</dn> comes, and is not silent – A fire consumes before <dn>Him</dn>, And it shall be very stormy all around <dn>Him</dn>.

readings.title: Gathering the Covenant Keepers
readings.subtitle: The Heavens Declare His Righteousness
readings.text: [4] <dn>He</dn> calls to the heavens from above, And to the earth, to rightly rule <dn>His</dn> people: [5] <dq>“Gather <dn>My</dn> lovingly-committed ones together to <dn>Me</dn>, Those who have made <dn>את</dn> a covenant with <dn>Me</dn> by slaughtering.”</dq> [6] Then the heavens declared <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> righteousness, For <dn>Elohim</dn> <dn>Himself</dn> is Judge. Selah.

readings.title: The Maker Requires No Provision
readings.subtitle: Examining the Sacrificial Economy
readings.text: [Psalm 50:7] <dq>“Hear, O <dn>My</dn> people, and <dn>I</dn> speak, O Yisra’ěl, and <dn>I</dn> witness against you: <dn>I</dn> am <dn>Elohim</dn>, your <dn>Elohim</dn>!</dq> [8] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> do not reprove you for your slaughterings, And your ascending offerings are continually before <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [9] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> do not take a bull from your house, Nor goats out of your pens.</dq> [10] <dq>“For every beast of the forest is <dn>Mine</dn>, The cattle on a thousand hills.</dq> [11] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> know all the birds of the mountains, And all moving in <dn>My</dn> field are <dn>Mine</dn>.</dq> [12] <dq>“If <dn>I</dn> were hungry, <dn>I</dn> would not speak to you; For the world is <dn>Mine</dn>, and all that fills it.</dq> [13] <dq>“Do <dn>I</dn> eat <dn>את</dn> the flesh of bulls, Or drink the blood of goats?</dq>

readings.title: The Tribute of Thanksgiving
readings.subtitle: Deliverance in the Day of Distress
readings.text: [14] <dq>“Slaughter <dn>את</dn> thanksgiving to <dn>Elohim</dn>, And pay <dn>את</dn> your vows to the Most High.</dq> [15] <dq>“And call upon <dn>Me</dn> in the day of distress – Let <dn>Me</dn> rescue you, and you esteem <dn>Me</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: The Hypocrisy of Anomia
readings.subtitle: Reciting the Covenant While Rejecting Instruction
readings.text: [Psalm 50:16] But to the wrong <dn>Elohim</dn> said, <dq>“What right have you to recite <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> laws, Or take <dn>My</dn> covenant in your mouth,</dq> [17] <dq>“While you hated instruction And cast <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Words behind you?</dq> [18] <dq>“When you saw a thief, you were pleased with him, And you take part with adulterers.</dq> [19] <dq>“You let your mouth loose to evil, And your tongue frames deceit.</dq> [20] <dq>“You sit, speak against your brother; You slander your own mother’s son.</dq> [21] <dq>“You have done this, and <dn>I</dn> kept silent; You have thought that <dn>I</dn> was altogether like you – <dn>I</dn> rebuke you, and set it in order before your eyes.</dq>

readings.title: The Premial Reward of Praise
readings.subtitle: Preparing a Way for Deliverance
readings.text: [22] <dq>“Understand this please, you who forget <dn>Eloah</dn>, Lest <dn>I</dn> tear you in pieces, With no one to deliver:</dq> [23] <dq>“Whoever slaughters praise esteems <dn>Me</dn>; And to him who prepares a way, <dn>I</dn> show the deliverance of <dn>Elohim</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: The Snare of Envy
readings.subtitle: Observing the Peace of the Wrong-Doers
readings.text: [Psalm 73:1] <dn>Elohim</dn> is truly good to Yisra’ěl, To those whose heart is clean. [2] But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled, My steps had nearly slipped. [3] For I was envious of the boasters, When I saw <dn>את</dn> the peace of the wrong-doers. [4] For death has no pangs for them, And their strength is firm. [5] They are not in trouble as other men, And they are not plagued like other men.

readings.title: The Arrogance of the Oppressors
readings.subtitle: Scoffing at the Knowledge of the Most High
readings.text: [6] So pride is their necklace, The garment of violence covers them. [7] Their eyes bulge from fatness; Their heart overflows with imaginations. [8] They mock and speak in the evil of oppression; They speak loftily. [9] They have set <dn>את</dn> their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walks through the earth, saying: [10] “Therefore <dn>His</dn> people return here, And waters of a filled cup are drained by them!” [11] And they have said, “How could <dn>Ěl</dn> know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?” [12] See, these are the wrong, And always at ease, They have amassed wealth!

readings.title: A Crisis of Functional Trust
readings.subtitle: The Perceived Futility of Innocence
readings.text: [13] Indeed, in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocence. [14] For I am plagued all day long, And my reproof is every morning.

readings.title: Perceiving the Terminal Verdict
readings.subtitle: The Awakening of the Sovereign
readings.text: [Psalm 73:15] If I had said, “Let me speak thus,” See, I would have deceived A generation of <dn>Your</dn> children. [16] Yet, when I tried to understand <dn>את</dn> this, It was labour to my eyes – [17] Until I went into the set-apart place of <dn>Ěl</dn>; Then I perceived their end. [18] Indeed, <dn>You</dn> set them in slippery places; <dn>You</dn> make them fall to ruins. [19] How suddenly they are ruined! Completely swept away through destructions. [20] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, when <dn>You</dn> awake <dn>You</dn> despise their image, As one does a dream after waking.

readings.title: Guided by Divine Counsel
readings.subtitle: From Ignorance to Esteem
readings.text: [21] For my heart was in a ferment, And I was pierced in my kidneys. [22] I was stupid and ignorant, I was like a beast toward <dn>You</dn>. [23] Yet I am always with <dn>You</dn>, <dn>You</dn> took hold of <dn>את</dn> my right hand. [24] <dn>You</dn> lead me by <dn>Your</dn> counsel, And afterward receive me unto esteem.

readings.title: The Rock and Eternal Portion
readings.subtitle: Refuge in the Master YeHoVaH
readings.text: [25] Whom do I have in the heavens? And I have desired no one besides <dn>You</dn> on earth. [26] My flesh and my heart shall waste away, But <dn>Elohim</dn> is the rock of my heart And my portion forever. [27] For look, those who are far from <dn>You</dn> perish; <dn>You</dn> shall cut off all those Who go whoring away from <dn>You</dn>. [28] But as for me, it is good to be near <dn>Elohim</dn>. I have made my refuge in the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, To declare <dn>את</dn> all <dn>Your</dn> works.

readings.title: Remembering the Redeemed Inheritance
readings.subtitle: The Endless Ruins of Mount Tsiyon
readings.text: [Psalm 74:1] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, why do <dn>You</dn> forever reject us? Why does <dn>Your</dn> displeasure smoke Against the sheep of <dn>Your</dn> pasture? [2] Remember <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> congregation. <dn>You</dn> did purchase of old, The tribe of <dn>Your</dn> inheritance. <dn>You</dn> did redeem, This Mount Tsiyon where <dn>You</dn> have dwelt. [3] Lift up <dn>Your</dn> steps to the endless ruins; The enemy has done all evil in the set-apart place.

readings.title: The Adversary's Systemic Destruction
readings.subtitle: Burning the Appointed Places of Ěl
readings.text: [4] <dn>Your</dn> adversaries have roared In the midst of <dn>Your</dn> appointments; They have set up their own signs as signs. [5] It seems as if one had lifted up Axes among the thick trees. [6] And now all its carved work, They have broken down with axe and hammer. [7] They have set fire to <dn>Your</dn> set-apart place, They have profaned <dn>את</dn> the dwelling place of <dn>Your</dn> Name to the ground. [8] They said in their hearts, “Let us suppress them altogether.” They burned all the Appointment Places of <dn>Ěl</dn> in the land.

readings.title: How Long Will the Enemy Reproach?
readings.subtitle: The Withheld Right Arm
readings.text: [9] We do not see our signs, There is no longer a prophet, Nor any among us who knows how long. [10] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, how long would the adversary reproach? Would the enemy despise <dn>Your</dn> Name forever? [11] Why do <dn>You</dn> hold back <dn>Your</dn> hand, even <dn>Your</dn> right hand? From the midst of <dn>Your</dn> bosom – end it!

readings.title: Sovereign Over Biological Engines
readings.subtitle: Breaking the Heads of Liviathan
readings.text: [Psalm 74:12] For <dn>Elohim</dn> is my Sovereign from of old, Working deliverance in the midst of the earth. [13] <dn>You</dn> divided the sea by <dn>Your</dn> might; <dn>You</dn> broke <dn>את</dn> the heads of the sea serpents in the waters. [14] <dn>You</dn> broke <dn>את</dn> the heads of Liviathan in pieces, <dn>You</dn> made him food for the people Living in the wilderness. [15] <dn>You</dn> did cleave open the fountain and the flood, <dn>You</dn> did dry up mighty rivers. [16] The day is <dn>Yours</dn>, the night is <dn>Yours</dn> too, <dn>You</dn> have established <dn>את</dn> the light and <dn>את</dn> the sun. [17] <dn>You</dn> have set all the borders of the earth, <dn>You</dn> have made summer and winter.

readings.title: The Guarantee of the Covenant
readings.subtitle: Haunts of Violence in the Earth
readings.text: [Psalm 74:18] Remember this: the enemy has reproached <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And a foolish people has despised <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> Name. [19] Do not give <dn>את</dn> the being of <dn>Your</dn> turtledove to the wild beast! Do not forget the life of <dn>Your</dn> afflicted ones forever. [20] Look to <dn>את</dn> the covenant, For the dark places of the earth are filled With haunts of violence. [21] Let not the crushed one return ashamed! Let the poor and needy praise <dn>Your</dn> Name.

readings.title: The Call for Absolute Justice
readings.subtitle: Arise, O Elohim, Plead Your Cause
readings.text: [22] Arise, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, plead <dn>Your</dn> own cause, Remember how the foolish man reproaches <dn>You</dn> daily. [23] Do not forget the voice of <dn>Your</dn> enemies, The uproar of those rising up against <dn>You</dn> increases continually.
